73
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, March 15, 2018/Phalguna 24, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Housing
and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 15
Serving eggs in Anganwadis
*211. SHRI T. RATHINAVEL: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Anganwadis
in many States were not providing eggs,
etc. to the children due to high cost of these
products;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had issued any
directives to States to ensure that the
Anganwadis serve the said food items as
was served in the past; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Urban transport under financial
stress
*212. SHRI DEREK O' BRIEN: Will
the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether urban transport is under
financial stress and if so, the details thereof
and the reasons therefor;
(b) whether Government plans to work
with State Governments to come out with
a rational pricing policy for metros and
buses to recover losses in urban transport
and if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures taken by Government
to improve public transport infrastructure
during the last three years?
Guidelines for disposal of waste under
SBM
*213. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:  Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether under the Swachh Bharat
Mission (SBM) any guidelines have been
prepared for disposal of waste by hospitals,
hotels, railway stations or other public

74
utilities and if so, the details thereof and if
not, the reasons therefor;
(b) the details of waste collected per
day from hospitals, hotels, railway stations
and other public utilities under SBM State/
UT-wise and how it has been disposed;
and
(c) whether any organisation has been
penalized for not following the guidelines
of SBM and if so,  the details thereof, State/
UT-wise and if not, the reasons therefor?
Corruption Perception Index 2017
*214.  SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether, as per the Corruption
Perception Index 2017, based on perceived
level of corruption in public sector by
Transparency International, India has been
placed at 81st position among 180
countries with a score of 40;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for failure  to curb
corruption in public sector in the country?
Making textbooks thinner and school
bags  lighter
*215. SHRI HARIVANSH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Curriculum Committee of the NCERT has
decided to make textbooks thinner and
school bags lighter, in order to reduce the
workload on students;
(b) whether any steps have been taken
to devise a mechanism to standardise the
quality of textbooks in the country during
the last one year;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what measures have been taken to
evaluate the quality of textbooks of private
publishers in the country?
Law against human trafficking
*216. SHRI N. GOKULA-
KRISHNAN: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is set to
introduce a law to guard against human
trafficking, proposing 10 year punishment
for those engaged in aggravated forms of
trafficking while seeking life imprisonment
for repeat offenders;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government, through the said Bill
proposes measures for relief and
rehabilitation of victims of trafficking and
seeks formation of a committee; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Budget allocation for survey on
substance abuse
*217. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the budget allocated for National
Survey on Extent and Pattern of Substance
Abuse and the modifications made
subsequently to it together with the reasons
therefor during the last three years;
(b) whether senior officials of the
Ministry have visited any Ministry funded
Integrated Rehabilitation Centres for
Addicts (IRCAs)  drug de-addiction centres
and if so, the dates of visits along with the
names of centres visited and the number of
visits to each such centre during the above
period; and

75
(c) the Budget Estimate, Revised
Estimate and Actual Expenditure incurred
on  prevention of drug abuse during the last
three years?
Construction of nuclear power
projects
*218. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of indigenous nuclear
power projects  under construction and the
number of those being built with foreign
collaborat

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, March 15, 2018/Phalguna 24, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Housing and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;  Planning;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Space; Statistics
and Programme Implementation; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 160
Uranium required, extracted and
imported for nuclear plants
2241. SHRI KIRANMAY NANDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the total quantity of uranium
required annually  to run nuclear power
plants in the country at full capacity;
(b) the quantity of uranium, the
country is able to extract and process; and
(c) the quantity of uranium presently
being imported to run the plants?
Power generation from nuclear plants
†2242. DR. SATY ANARAYAN
JATIYA: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) the installed power generation
capacity, utilisation of the capacity and
production cost per unit of each of the
nuclear power plants in the country,
plant-wise; and
(b) the details of action plan to establish
new nuclear power stations every year
during the next five years, the power
generation capacity, cost and requirement
and supply of atomic fuel for these stations?
Proposal for nuclear power plants in
States
2243. SHRI K. SOMAPRASAD: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to set
up nuclear power plants in various States;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
Kerala is included therein; and
(c) the role of Nuclear Power
Corporation of India Ltd. (NPCIL) in the
field of atomic energy generation?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

528
Accidents in nuclear power plants
2244. SHRI K. SOMAPRASAD: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of nuclear power plants
operating in the country in various fields
such as power generation, research and
development, defence and pharmaceutical
sectors; and
(b) the details of accidents and
explosions and loss of human life in various
atomic power stations during the last three
years?
Consultations for framing policies
2245. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister
of DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has evolved
any policy of consulting stakeholders while
preparing new policies or guidelines
pertaining to the Ministry and if so, the
details thereof and if not, the reasons
therefor;
(b) what has been the result of such
consultations across the stakeholders during
the last three years;
(c) what are the details about the
national level organisations involved in such
consultations; and
(d) the key suggestions received in such
consultations and accepted by the
Ministry/Department during the above
period?
Asia-Pacific Corridor
2246. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is making
efforts to reach an understanding among
the stakeholder countries, including Japan,
for establishing Asia-Pacific Corridor;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this Corridor is primarily
aimed to focus on trade relations or other
aspects of mutual interests would also be
covered under this initiative; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bilateral agreements for repatriation
of prisoners
2247. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A:
SHRIMATI VANDANA
CHAV AN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Indian nationals lodged
in foreign prisons—domicile-wise, sex-
wise, offence-wise and category-wise,
convicts and under-trials;
(b) the total number of applications for
repatriation received and total number of
Indian nationals repatriated from foreign
prisons since the enactment of the
Repatriation of Prisoners Act in 2003;
(c) the number of countries with which
India has bilateral agreements in regard to
repatriation of prisoners; and
(d) the inter-ministerial process of
interaction between different Ministries
and Departments (in the Government of
India, e.g. MEA and MHA) and what is
the average time taken to process such
repatriation requests?

529
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Increase in Chinese activities around
Arunachal and Doklam border area
†2248. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRIMATI CHHAY A
VERMA:
SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
unprecedented rise is being witnessed in
the Chinese activities along the border with
Arunachal Pradesh and Doklam and it also
includes espionage and increasing number
of soldiers;
(b) the steps being taken by
Government in view of the Chinese
activities near Indian border; and
(c) the factual position in this regard?
Bhutan China negotiations for
exchange of Doklam area
